mapper.sql: c.channel_seq, c.channel_id, c.channel_name, c.channel_type, c.sort_order, c.use_yn, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_channel_sku m WHERE m.channel_seq = c.channel_seq) AS mapping_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_channel_sku m WHERE m.channel_seq = c.channel_seq AND m.mapping_status <> 'MAPPED') AS pending_count

where.if: AND ( LOWER(c.channel_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(c.channel_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_channel WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_channel SET channel_name = #{channelName}, channel_type = #{channelType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE channel_seq = #{channelSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_channel_sku WHERE channel_seq = #{channelSeq}
